scope: Legacy explicit-root read-only composition plus locally implemented selected-plugin behavior; this is not a wholesale or behavior-equivalent DSH skills migration. Selected-plugin resources and hooks have their own admitted owners; legacy-root exclusions below do not describe that profile.
adaptations: Legacy explicit roots: no implicit home/project/environment roots, bundles, resource loading or script execution.
Fixed descriptor-owned manifest and digest reads use existing fstools.OpenScopedTextFiles; catalog is not a second runtime registry or permission engine.
Existing Harness runtime, ToolRegistry and PreStep own registration/generation and admission; one exact-key skill tool lists or reads. Explicit gestures reuse the same frozen catalog read.

Legacy explicit roots: only direct child SKILL.md files. Duplicate names and invalid files fail closed. Bounded UTF-8 text; model-disabled skills remain unavailable. Selected plugins separately support user-only invocation without model publication.

Explicit slash invocation and reattachment use exact authorized registration availability before deferred discovery; denied or shadowed skills remain unavailable. This is a local integration fix, not a claim of upstream equivalence.

Post-compaction restoration filters exact activated instruction content already present on the current surface, correlating successful Skill results separately from short activation notices. Restored text continues checkpoint progress instead of implying a fresh invocation; preprocessing and turn grants are not rerun.

Durable bounded summary catalogs reconcile against Session surface identity and pending messages. Existing exact visible registration and Skill denial rules own visibility; PostCompact restores guidance before overflow retries. No filesystem discovery, resource execution, permission changes or new persistent state.
license: No new blanket license assigned. Source files have no embedded third-party notice. Existing dependency-specific notices and ownership decisions remain unchanged.

behavioral_audit.role: Behavioral reference, not copied implementation: direct-user legacy gestures and visibility-matched durable catalog publication through existing hooks. Same-input actual official catalog-hook runner uses mocked registration/snapshot/session seams; full runtime parity remains unverified.
behavioral_audit.acceptance_scope: Issue 73's seven-item auditable behavior matrix, not full Harness equivalence.
